services.desc: Westcreek - Earth Day UTV Adventure & Forest Clean-Up Join us for a special afternoon of fun and help pick up litter while on a trail ride in Pike National Forest. This event is sponsored by Focus on the Forest and Great Outdoors Adventures (GOA). Your 3 hour adventure is provided by GOA at 1/2 price as our way of saying thank you for helping us clean the trails and campsites while on your ride. Rent a UTV and help cleaning-up Pike National Forest! April 22 ONLY

quotes.author: Ashley Fehrle
quotes.text: Ashley Fehrle10 months agoSooooo much fun! Gideon was so informative and helpful! Great job explaining the course and all the safety rules. The self guided tour was awesome! The GPS on the Rzr we had was great and if you have downloaded music, the speakers were fantastic! There is absolutely no service out there so look up the map before you leave. We were able to take a backpack on the trail with snacks and water. The views were amazing and the red trail had so many fun bumps and water crossings! If you are looking for fun adventure, this is the place to go!!!

quotes.author: Fermin VargasSegura
quotes.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND 4+ hr trail !!! Even with a group of a dozen people we were warmly greeted and accommodated perfectly. Angelica did her best to make this a very memorable experience and assured we were in for a safe and thrilling ride. Jason and Gideon were excellent at explaining the RZR capabilities, routes, safety procedures and protocols. After receiving a thorough training video from these 2 gentlemen we we're geared up and ready to go!

quotes.author: Sidni Garwood
quotes.text: Sidni Garwood2 months agoWe had a great time with our Jeep rental on family vacation! My kids loved the fun trails we got to go on, thanks to the awesome staff suggestions…we wouldn’t have had a clue where to go otherwise! Specifically want to note how kind and helpful Skyler was who helped check us in, get our vehicle, and set us up with Apple map routes of where to go. Would recommend making a reservation for some fun memories!

quotes.author: Jasmeet Johar
quotes.text: Jasmeet Johar11 months agoWe on a UTV ride with friends on vacation. Staff was very friendly, UTV was clean, the Bluetooth speakers didn’t work but overall we had a great experience. The trails and ride was 2 hour long, plan ahead and keep your pace so that you can reach back on time. The areas with water puddles on the way were a blast to navigate through. Overall great experience and would highly recommend!

quotes.author: Ashley Quinlan
quotes.text: Ashley Quinlan3 months agoSkylar was absolutely amazing! He took us to the most beautiful spots and somehow managed to spot wildlife everywhere. We still don't know how he saw half of the animals he pointed out! He was knowledgeable, friendly, and made the entire ATV tour unforgettable. If you're lucky enough to get Skylar as your guide, you're in for an incredible experience. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Juan Martinez
quotes.text: Juan Martinez8 months agoThis activity was exceptionally enjoyable. The management team was remarkably friendly and helpful in explaining the various trails. Although I had my own vehicle, I would highly recommend visiting the establishment to obtain a map. They provided clear guidance on suitable trails for beginner off-roaders in snowy conditions, ensuring I would not become stranded.
